$comment: Shared sources. Levels: 1 — law, decree, constitution or official government document (1g — government guideline without the force of law); 2 — Album des pavillons (SHOM); 3 — Flags and Anthems Manual London 2012; 4 — FOTW and other vexillological secondary sources; 5 — Wikipedia, Wikimedia Commons, hampusborgos, catamphetamine and other flag sets: comparison only, no geometry or color is taken from them. The via field says how the source was read: direct — the document itself, fotw — a transcription on FOTW, wikipedia — a Wikipedia quotation citing the document. accessed — date read.

album2023.title: Album des pavillons nationaux et des marques distinctives, SHOM, 2023 edition (and 2025)
album2023.access: Paid publication. In the pilot it was read only through quotations on FOTW (via: fotw). The 2025 edition has not been read — gap.

album2000.title: Album des pavillons nationaux et des marques distinctives, SHOM, 2000 edition with corrections

london2012.title: LOCOG, Flags and Anthems Manual London 2012
london2012.access: The PDF is available. Pantone values in the pilot were taken through FOTW quotations. All flags in it are drawn at 2:3 — these are NOC recommendations, not government specifications.

fotw.title: Flags of the World (crwflags.com)
fotw.access: Read through a web fetch tool; the build environment's shell cannot reach the site.

naturalearth.title: Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 (public domain), via the npm package world-atlas 2.0.2
naturalearth.access: Geodata for the map silhouettes on the CY and XK flags. This is real geography, not the official drawing of the map on the flag.

cldr.title: Unicode CLDR 45 (cldr-core, cldr-localenames-modern): alpha-3 and numeric codes, names

comparison.title: Wikipedia, Wikimedia Commons, hampusborgos/country-flags, catamphetamine/country-flag-icons, flagcolorcodes.com
comparison.access: Comparison only, and as a provisional color when levels 1–4 give no numeric value. Every such color is marked provisional.

album2023-pantone-map.title: Pantone → RGB table as given by Album 2023 (assembled from the entries for different countries on FOTW)
conflicts: 287c: 0-53-152 (#003598) for NZ, 0-53-128 (#003580) for BR. The same Pantone gets two RGB values within one edition.
